snippet.title: What's the Password? - Releasing May 28th
snippet.description:
Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4095490
Preregister on iOS: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/whats-the-password/id6762288718
Preregister on Android: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.trampolinetales.wtp

"What's the Password?" is a minimalistic puzzle game where you decode 4-digit passwords. Featuring over 100 puzzles!
Coming to Steam & Mobile on May 28th.

https://TrampolineTales.com/
